scripts.build: npm run build:website && npm run build:app
scripts.build:website: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --project website/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build website
scripts.build:app: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --project app/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build app
scripts.electron: npm run build:app && node scripts/run_electron.cjs app
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:app && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('app/build','build',{recursive:true})" && electron-builder --config app/electron-builder.json --win && node scripts/sign_release.cjs
scripts.package: npm run build:app && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('app/build','build',{recursive:true})" && electron-builder --config app/electron-builder.json --win && node scripts/sign_release.cjs
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build:app && electron-builder --config app/electron-builder.json --win portable
